note: Provenance for every asset wired into the bundle. An asset is wired only after its bytes are compared against the canonical source; the marks are used AS SUPPLIED, so a later edit to one of these files is a brand violation rather than a style choice. scripts/design-system/ds-audit.mjs recomputes each sha256 and fails on drift, which is what makes a silent recolor impossible to land.
